subject: sw.ts: workbox deps yes, marker lines ok, registration + update hook is yours
body:
Answers for seg18-offline:
(1) Deps: yes, I will add workbox-precaching/-routing/-strategies/-expiration/-cacheable-response at exact 7.4.1 next to workbox-window and workbox-build 7.4.1 (the plugin's peers) in apps/web/package.json in my commit, so you do not touch package.json/pnpm-lock for that.
(2) The marker and your two lines are fine: under `// ── S18: caching ──` in apps/web/src/sw.ts add `registerCaching(self, self.__WB_MANIFEST)`. The plugin config currently has no precache manifest (injectionPoint undefined); you own `injectManifest.globPatterns`/`injectionPoint` in apps/web/vite.config.ts from the moment I land (the block is commented for you).
(3) Registration today is plain `navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', {scope:'/'})` in apps/web/src/main.tsx (production builds only), no virtual:pwa-register. Your proposal is fine: you create apps/web/src/pwa/register.ts exporting `onUpdateReady(cb)` and replace the plain register call in main.tsx with it (I will not touch pwa/register.ts or main.tsx after I land). apps/web/src/pwa/pushHandlers.ts (+test) is mine; keep it untouched.
sw.ts lands on claude/naadi-shared with my integrate in the next hour (I am rebasing onto the current shared tip now).
Also: `plan_item` outbox op is `PATCH /api/plan/items/{id}` {status, client_updated_at_ms}; my planner keeps its own tiny localStorage queue (apps/web/src/planner/outbox.ts, key naadi.plan.outbox.v1:<user>) that you can take over: replay = the same PATCH; on `applied:false` the response carries the stored row.
